T-DIF-07's generated-design corpora assert two invariances that do not hold, and the SPEC states them as facts. Seed check: tests/Physics was run in copies with Tol.PROP_BASE_SEED changed and Perf.spec removed. 0xDEADBEEF and 0x0C0FFEE1 pass (335/335). Three seeds fail: 0x13579BDF (333/335), 0x2468ACE0 (334/335) and 0x7A11C0DE (334/335).

(a) The Gen corpus's Y draw alone (yKept) fails twice:
- 0x13579BDF case 220 (case seed 2182004987): Y 0.7151 moves Hammering g 0.2183 → 0.2151, |ΔG| 0.0032, which is past TOL_G_INVARIANT.
- 0x7A11C0DE case 430 (seed 3036987717): Y 0.4831 moves g 0.0211 → 0.0266, |ΔG| 0.0055, with Thinness 0.0501 → 0.0640.

(d) Every Block written (b, a, c) fails twice:
- 0x2468ACE0 case 92 (seed 3475348525): Thinness on All 0.3756 → 0.3736, Hammering g 0.3065 → 0.3058.
- 0x13579BDF case 417 (seed 871064962): Thinness 9.8e-5 → 0.

Cause, traced with work\yfacewhy.luau, writewhy*.luau: in every case the only τ that moves by more than 1e-9 belongs to a tip Block's samples (6 of 18) that lie within 1e-12 of the blade's top face. This is O11's face tie. In the writing case the blade itself is the part rewritten: its top face comes out in other last bits, and the probe's Z chord flips 0.0496 → 0.1096.

Across six property streams (3,000 designs, work\faceties.luau):
- Y alone moves G on 53 designs, up to 0.0055.
- Rewriting the Blocks moves G on 2, up to 0.0007.
- No tier flips, and EdgeLength never moves.
- One Y shift moves G (0.1862 → 0.1863) without Thinness, through M2's sampled round-part overlaps (Volume, SurfaceComplexity). yKept forbids that too.

What this makes false or understated:
- O11: "another writing of a part moves nothing".
- §5.2: "takes the same probes and chords".
- §0.5: invariant to how a part is written, a Y shift being the only tie.
- §14.6 T-DIF-07 (a) "along their Y draw alone the same" and (d) "the same steps".
- The "12 of 500 … up to 0.0016" in §5, §5.6 and O11.

The L3 gate is green only on the chosen seed.

pass is false: one major issue stands.

**The major issue.** T-DIF-07's generated-design corpora fail on 3 of 5 other PROP_BASE_SEED values, and the SPEC states the same false invariances:
- A Y shift moves G by up to 0.0055, past TOL_G_INVARIANT.
- Rewriting a Block moves Thinness (ΔG 0.0007).
- O11 says another writing of a part moves nothing.

The cause is O11's face tie, which another writing of the touched part also re-rounds. M2's sampled round-part overlaps can move G under a shift too. Neither has flipped a tier in 3,000 designs. A test patch was tried (out\fixT_invariance.diff): it passes on four seeds and `verify --quick` stays green. SPEC text was tried too.

- §5.5, the goldens, E-S2.9 and the prototype comparison check out cell for cell.
- The physics frame moved only designs with a cleaned Grip or Guard part (15 fixtures, 1,785 plausible designs).
- The lattice Douglas–Peucker is exact, costs nothing, and moved only the 12 fixtures listed.
- 26 of 27 mutants are killed; the survivor is equivalent.
- Every functional test passes in both whole-suite runs and in the clean verify.

- E-S2.13 misdates a bit-identity claim, and fix round 1's effect beyond the 70 fixtures is unrecorded: 164 played tiers flipped on plausible designs, 2 on generated designs, and worst valid 4.
- §4.1, §16.18 and the \"runs it last\" text are wrong.
- Wedge re-cuts reach |ΔG| 0.0521; the X-mirror cause is now traced.
- Timing gates sit at their limits under ordinary load (59.8 ms against the 60 ms guard; --quick 30.2 s). A quiet re-time was impossible.
- Some pins changed without a note in the test.
